topic: Get your hours, phone, and address consistent everywhere online
caption:
Scattered business info is a silent customer killer.
Different hours on Yelp vs. Google? Customers give up.
Three places to check today: Google, Yelp, Facebook.
Make them match exactly. No website needed to start.
Want a site that anchors all of it? Link in bio.

copy.headline: Same info everywhere. Customers find you.

copy.check2: Check Yelp and Facebook for matching hours.
